scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT phonon and force calculations is infeasible in the verifier; result-level compare of reported values against paper-derived gold is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target minimum phonon frequency at 16 GPa for K8Si46, derived from paper's phonon band structure (Fig. 3b) showing collapse of K-related branch to imaginary frequencies.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3(b) and surrounding discussion; approximate central value of the imaginary mode.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Rounded to -100 cm⁻¹ to reflect the approximate collapse; the exact numeric value is not needed because the qualitative result (imaginary mode) is the claim.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is an approximation consistent with the paper's observation that the K phonon branch becomes imaginary at 16 GPa; tolerances are set wide enough that any reasonable DFT re-run will land in the range.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target Hellmann-Feynman force on K atom at symmetry site along b axis at 16 GPa, derived from paper's force-displacement curve (Fig. 3d).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3(d) shows a positive force pushing the K atom off-center; approximate zero-displacement force ~0.05 eV/Å.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Rounded value from the figure; the exact number is not reported numerically, so we use a representative order-of-magnitude and sign.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value captures the sign and approximate magnitude of the force that confirms off-center instability; tolerance absorbs methodology differences.

minimum_frequency.description: Lowest phonon frequency across the Brillouin zone, in cm⁻¹

outputs.description: Reproduce the phonon instability: minimum phonon frequency of K8Si46 at 16 GPa. A negative value indicates imaginary modes.

force.description: Hellmann-Feynman force on the K atom along the b axis, in eV/Å

outputs.description: Verify the off-center stabilization: force on the K atom at its symmetry site (1/4, 1/2, 0) along the b direction.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the computational evidence for a phonon-driven isostructural transition. The scored quantities are the minimum phonon frequency and the on-site force, both at 16 GPa. Tolerances will be applied to account for code/pseudopotential differences.

steps.description: Minimum phonon frequency: paper reports imaginary mode ~ -100 cm⁻¹; tolerance ±50 cm⁻¹ accounts for code/pseudopotential spread.
Hellmann-Feynman force on K at symmetry site: paper indicates positive force ~0.05 eV/Å; tolerance ±0.02 eV/Å.
